speaker: bull
content: AAPL presents a compelling long thesis driven by three key catalysts. First, the $90B buyback signals management's confidence in intrinsic value far above current trading levels. Historically, Apple's buybacks have added 3-4% to annual EPS growth. Second, Services revenue continues to compound at 15%+ annually, now representing over 25% of total revenue with 70%+ gross margins — this mix shift alone supports multiple expansion. Third, the upcoming iPhone cycle with AI integration could drive an accelerated upgrade cycle, similar to the 5G cycle in 2021 which added ~8% to revenue. The primary risk is China competition, but Apple's premium positioning has proven resilient through multiple cycles. Estimated upside: 12-15% over 3 months.
